title: 第5章 仙法全免费第6章 不行你太小了
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
在诸葛风挑选仙法之时，外面的两人，已经是大眼瞪小眼了。
“你你你.......”萧灵汐瞪大了双眸，不可置信的盯着苏白，她感觉自己今晚遇到的事情都颠覆了她的认知。
本来以为可以行侠仗义打假一个骗子，结果，没想到打到真的了。
苏白背负双手，笑呵呵道：“小丫头，现在，你还怀疑我是骗子吗？”
“我.......”萧灵汐哑口无言，脸颊涨红一片，低头嘀咕道：“我哪知道，你竟然是真的有本事的人？”
苏白摇了摇头，懒得跟一个黄毛小丫头计较。
而这时，诸葛风也从仙法阁中走了出来，他手中捧着一个黄色卷轴，恭恭敬敬的来到了苏白的面前。
“师尊，这仙法需要多少银子？如果只要炼气第一重的仙法，又需要多少银子？”
他的声音有些颤抖，一旁的萧灵汐也将目光望了过来。
仙法，乃是一个宗门立足之本！
很多宗门，都将仙法视如珍宝，是不断吸引弟子的源头。
就以灵霄宗来说，灵霄宗的镇宗仙法灵霄诀，乃是上等仙法。
要如何学到灵霄诀呢？
首先，需要成为杂役弟子，经过半年的时间，通过正式考核，成为正式弟子。
其次，需要完成各种宗门任务，得到积分点，积分足够了，才能拥有兑换灵霄诀的资格。
最后，有了兑换资格之后，并不是免费修炼，而是还需要花钱购买！
炼气一重诀窍：100两银子
炼气二重诀窍：300两银子
炼气三重诀窍：100两黄金
一两黄金等于十两银子，100两黄金，那就是一千两银子！

这还只是炼气境前三重的功法，那后面的，价格更加高的离谱呢！
还是那句话，没钱你修什么仙？
老老实实当一介凡人不好吗？
仙法如此珍贵，诸葛风怎么不颤抖？
这道经，即使他还没有开始修炼，便隐隐觉得不是寻常仙法，其珍贵程度，怕是不比灵霄诀差。
可仙法摆在他面前，他现在也没有银子购买啊！
“银子？什么银子？”
苏白被搞懵了。
他穿越之前看了那么多小说，不都是弟子加入宗门，然后就可以修炼仙法，全程免费的么？
怎么到自己这儿，反而要银子了？
诸葛风愣了一下，以为苏白没有听清楚，旋即赶忙道：“师尊，弟子要修炼这仙法，需要支付多少银子？”
“无需银子，你既是我天道宗弟子，自然可以随意修炼我天道宗的仙法。”苏白笑道。
诸葛风愣住了，脑袋里像是有炸弹在爆炸，嗡嗡作响。
如此珍贵的仙法，免费？
“师尊，炼气一重到炼气九重的仙法，都不需要银子？”
他不敢相信，甚至以为自己出现幻听了。
前三重的仙法就已经是天价了，全九重........
“怎么，你不愿意？”苏白眉毛轻挑，似笑非笑的说道：“我给你机会修炼仙法，可别辜负了我的期待啊！”
诸葛风抬头望去，自家师尊负手而立，面带微笑，宛如今晚那皎月般熠熠生辉。
月光如水华般倾泻而下，将他映衬得好似谪仙降世，仿佛是那下凡拯救苍生的仙人。

再回想自己在灵霄宗做杂役时的艰苦，以及那备受打压的日子，与此刻形成了天壤之别。
他的身躯如触电般剧烈颤抖起来，一股汹涌澎湃的热血如火山喷发般涌上心头，径直冲向头顶。
“噗通。”
content_en:
When Zhuge Feng was choosing the immortal method, the two people outside were already staring at each other.
"You, you, you..." Xiao Lingxi's eyes widened, staring at Su Bai in disbelief. She felt that what she encountered tonight had subverted her cognition.
I thought I could fight a liar with a heroic spirit, but in the end, I didn't expect that I would hit the real one.
Su Bai put his hands behind his back and said with a smile: "Little girl, now, do you still suspect that I am a liar?"
"I..." Xiao Lingxi was speechless, her cheeks turned red, she lowered her head and muttered: "How did I know that you are actually a really capable person?"
Su Bai shook his head, too lazy to argue with a little girl with yellow hair.
At this time, Zhuge Feng also walked out of the Immortal Law Pavilion. He held a yellow scroll in his hand and came to Su Bai respectfully.
"Master, how much silver is needed for this immortal technique? If I only want the first level of qi refining, how much silver is needed?"
His voice was trembling, and Xiao Lingxi on the side also looked over.
Immortal magic is the foundation of a sect!
Many sects regard immortal magic as a treasure and a source of constant attraction for disciples.
As far as Lingxiao Sect is concerned, Lingxiao Sect's sect-suppressing immortal method, Lingxiao Jue, is a superior immortal method.
How to learn Lingxiao Jue?
First, you need to become a handyman disciple. After half a year, you must pass the formal assessment and become a formal disciple.
Secondly, you need to complete various sect tasks and get points. If you have enough points, you can be qualified to redeem Lingxiao Jue.
Finally, after you have the redemption qualification, it is not free to practice, but you need to spend money to purchase it!
The secret to the first level of Qi refining: 100 taels of silver
The secret to the second level of Qi refining: 300 taels of silver
The third secret to refining Qi: 100 taels of gold
One tael of gold is equal to ten taels of silver, and 100 taels of gold is equivalent to one thousand taels of silver!
These are only the first three levels of Qi Refining Realm. The prices for the later ones are even more ridiculous!
Again, if you don’t have money, how can you become an immortal?
Isn't it good to just be a mortal?
Immortal magic is so precious, why doesn't Zhuge Feng tremble?
Even before he started practicing this Tao Sutra, he had a vague feeling that it was not an ordinary immortal method. It was probably no less precious than the Lingxiao Jue.
But the immortal magic is in front of him, and he doesn’t have the money to buy it now!
"Silver? What silver?"
Su Bai was confused.
He had read so many novels before traveling through time. Didn't all disciples join the sect and then they can practice immortal magic, all for free?
Why do you need money when you come here?
Zhuge Feng was stunned for a moment, thinking that Su Bai didn't hear clearly, and immediately said: "Master, how much money does the disciple need to pay to practice this immortal method?"
"No money is needed. Since you are a disciple of my Tiandao Sect, you can naturally practice the immortal skills of my Tiandao Sect at will." Su Bai said with a smile.
Zhuge Feng was stunned, as if a bomb was exploding in his head, buzzing.
Such precious magic, free of charge?
"Master, the immortal methods from the first level to the ninth level of Qi refining don't require silver?"
He couldn't believe it and even thought he was hallucinating.
The first three levels of immortal magic are already extremely expensive, and the entire ninth level...
"Why, you don't want to?" Su Bai raised his eyebrows lightly and said with a half-smile: "I'll give you the opportunity to practice immortal magic, but don't let down my expectations!"
Zhuge Feng looked up and saw his master standing with his hands behind his hands, smiling, shining like the bright moon tonight.
The moonlight poured down like water, making him look like a banished immortal coming to the world, as if he were the immortal who came down to earth to save the common people.
When I think back to the hardships I experienced working as a handyman in the Lingxiao Sect, and the days when I was suppressed, it is completely different from now.
His body trembled violently like an electric shock, and a surging hot blood surged into his heart like a volcano erupting, rushing straight to the top of his head.
“Plop.”
